shared_root_touches.written_in_tree_rationale: The ledger's own recorded integrator deviation (section 5 note, 2026-07-25) accepts a lane writing its assigned migration directly when the integrator lands it in the same pass; a manifest round-trip would add a copy step with drift risk and no safety gain. The number came from the ledger, never from `ls`.
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE ont_builtin_catalog_installs: PRIMARY KEY (org_id) -> PRIMARY KEY (org_id, catalog_version); the table becomes an append-only per-tenant history of applied catalog versions. FORCE RLS org_isolation policy, org-immutable trigger, and the 0165 grants (mnt_ontology_writer SELECT+INSERT, no UPDATE; mnt_rt SELECT only) are all unchanged. No object in the repository references this table by foreign key.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ontology_api.install_builtin_catalog(UUID, TEXT, JSONB, UUID, TEXT, TEXT): identical signature and return type; body becomes an idempotent additive install. Ownership (mnt_ontology_writer) and the EXECUTE grant (mnt_ontology_cmd only, never mnt_rt) are re-asserted explicitly.
removed_error_codes: ontology_builtin.different_catalog_already_installed (SQLSTATE 23505) - superseded by the additive path; no test, crate, client or document referenced it
retained_error_codes: ontology_builtin.empty_org_required - still raised for a tenant's FIRST catalog install
